description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Order No.33, made for fixing Maximum Retail Prices for sale 50 kg bag of Cement w.e.f. 31.03.2015 & Rescind Order No. 30 published in Gaz. Ex. No. 1902/47
categorisation: This gazette content contains a regulatory order issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes maximum retail prices for cement products and rescinds a previous order, making it a legal/regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and compliance requirements.
